ItemID: unavailable; Title: Iowa Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggression fits my heavier listening, but I would choose something more melodic this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hooks fit my rock interests, but I am more drawn to the metal albums here today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Oncoming Storm; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its heavy riffs and melodic passages appeal to my interest in In Flames and Soilwork.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Through the Ashes of Empires; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves sound appealing, but it is a lower priority than the melodic metal choices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: New Killer America Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its nu-metal direction is less appealing right now than the melodic heaviness I want.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ashes Of The Wake Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The forceful riffs appeal to the heavier side of my listening, especially after Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: True Self Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Having listened to Scars makes another SOiL album interesting, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic guitar work sounds promising, but I would prioritize bands closer to my recent metal listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Clayman; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I have listened to several In Flames albums, so this is my strongest choice for more of their melodic heaviness.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic thrash direction fits my taste, but I would explore it after the albums I selected.
